source_en:
Once more, I am roused from my sleep by gut-wrenching nightmares. The frequency is now unbearable, and I can no longer sustain my life this way.

Again I find  myself in the graveyard behind St. Uriel’s chapel, under that same accursed crimson moonlight basking the yard in an ethereal haze.

There, cloaked men gathered around that rotten, gnarled tree, whispering profane and terrible things before a woman chained to its trunk. Suddenly, I am taken behind her eyes, and I witness the men brandish a knife.

I am spared witness to the bloodshed, but I cannot help but feel it's true.
Why am I seeing this?

source_en:
Tomas, my love — 

Your last reached me Tuesday. I've read it three times. The hand wasn't yours. I know your hand — eight years of it. The loops don't crowd like that, and you have never once spelt my name with the second N. 

Tell me you wrote it. Tell me your wrist is hurt and one of the kinder ones wrote for you. Tell me anything and I'll believe it, only write back in your own hand. 

I went to the gates yesterday with bread. The new Sister wouldn't take it. No visitors to the lower wards, she said. She wouldn't look at me. 

Lily asks for you every night. Write me. Write me in your own hand and I'll burn this. 

— Your Anya

source_en: Though man yet remains on this earth, we live in dread for how much longer. A new race walks among us, towering giants of incredible strength, agility, and innate tallents for sorcery and angelic foresight. They are in every way superior to us and yet do not know their nature. As mankind rebuilds we must live alongside beings who have known nothing but war and posesses talents that far exceed our own. Though some have pleged their service to rebuilding efforts other have taken to criminality, banditry or mercenary work. Most terrible is the tragedy of Saedrys where a Nephilim appeared to have gone "feral" and burnt what was left of the city to the ground. These creatures must be controlled or expelled from the realm, their freedom threatens our safety and we must seek any means to qwell their potential for destruction.
ar_before: ما زال الإنسان على هذه الأرض، غير أننا نحيا في رعبٍ من طول ما بقي لنا. يمشي بيننا جنس جديد: عمالقة شاهقون، ذوو قوة مذهلة ورشاقة ومواهب فطرية في السحر والاستبصار الملائكي. يفوقوننا في كل شيء، ولا يعرفون مع ذلك حقيقة أنفسهم. وبينما يعيد البشر البناء، علينا أن نعيش إلى جانب كائنات لم تعرف غير الحرب، وتملك من المواهب ما يفوق مواهبنا بمراحل. وإن تعهّد بعضهم بخدمة جهود إعادة الإعمار، فقد انحدر آخرون إلى الإجرام والسلب والارتزاق. وأفظع ذلك مأساة سايدريس، حيث بدا أن أحد النيفيليم قد صار "متوحّشًا" فأحرق ما بقي من المدينة حتى صار رمادًا. لا بد من ضبط هذه المخلوقات أو نفيها من العالم؛ فحريتها تهدّد سلامتنا، وعلينا التماس أي وسيلة لكبح ما فيها من قدرة على التدمير.
